strengths: Clean luxury HUD typography and responsive layout that adapts seamlessly to the 700x900 narrow viewport without overlaps.
Detailed procedural horological surface motifs, including Côtes de Genève striping, perlage mainplate textures, and legible macro callouts.
defects_and_ai_tells: Exploded CAD view exposes flat, zero-thickness 2.5D sprite planes masquerading as 3D geometry rather than true extruded CAD solids.
Severe draw-call bottleneck (941 draw calls for 6,966 triangles) causing sluggish 29.9 median FPS, 14.9 P10 FPS, and an 8.4s load time.
In Macro 2.4x mode, the enlarged 'CHRONOS CAL. N-4' dial plaque collides with and obscures the top-left header subtitle text.
actionable_r2_fixes: Batch static watch components and use instanced rendering for gear teeth, screws, and jewels to cut draw calls below 100 and hit 60 FPS.
Extrude the flat layer planes into true 3D beveled meshes with anisotropic metallic PBR shaders so the exploded view has physical volume.
Add safe-zone clipping or dynamic HUD fading in Macro mode to prevent zoomed movement plaques from overlapping header typography.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 고급스러운 시계 공학 UI 레이아웃과 정교한 표면 텍스처 표현은 준수하나, 분해 뷰에서 드러나는 평면적인 2.5D 그래픽의 한계가 명확합니다. 과도한 드로우 콜로 인한 프레임 저하와 매크로 모드의 텍스트 겹침 문제를 해결하고 실제 두께감을 가진 3D 지오메트리로 개선해야 합니다.

strengths: Refined luxury typography, cohesive rose-gold palette, and clean responsive HUD adaptation in the narrow viewport.
Detailed horological finishing cues, including perlage on the mainplate and clear Swiss lever escapement geometry in macro view.
Informative domain telemetry (torque cascade, beat rate, power reserve) integrated seamlessly into the control panel.
defects_and_ai_tells: Broken spatial anchoring in Exploded view: left-side callout leader lines (02–06) terminate in empty space rather than tracking component bounds.
2.5D flatness tell: Exploded view exposes paper-thin stacked planes lacking extruded gear teeth, bridge sidewalls, or true PBR lighting.
Severe draw-call bloat (937 draw calls for 7,179 triangles) and a 11.3s load time cause frame drops to 35–45 FPS in Macro and Exploded modes.
Minor spatial collision in the narrow layout where bottom-left status text touches the lower watch lug.
actionable_r2_fixes: Batch static watch geometry and Merge/Instance gear teeth to reduce the 937 draw calls below 50 and stabilize 60 FPS.
Extrude 2D silhouettes into volumetric 3D meshes with chamfered bevels and environment-mapped metallic shaders for authentic depth.
Project dynamic 3D world-space centroids to 2D screen coordinates so Exploded CAD leader lines accurately attach to their target parts.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 고급스러운 시계 공학 UI 타이포그래피와 반응형 레이아웃 구성은 준수하나, 분해 뷰에서 부품의 두께감이 없는 평면적 한계와 지시선 좌표 이탈 결함이 드러납니다. 937개에 달하는 드로우콜 병목과 긴 초기 로딩을 최적화하고 정교한 3D 볼륨감을 보강해야 합니다.

strengths: Cohesive 1936 period-piece art direction with crisp UI typography and clear visual hierarchy.
Detailed mechanical centerpiece featuring legible gauges, brass accents, and synchronized HUD tape visualization.
Clean responsive layout adaptation in the narrow viewport with zero HUD overlaps or console errors.
defects_and_ai_tells: Excessive draw calls (635 for 71k triangles) resulting in sluggish frame rates (30 FPS median, 20 FPS P10) and slow initialization (13.9s).
UI state desynchronization in Screenshot 3: dropdown selects '3-State Busy Beaver', while the description and tape register still display 'Binary +1 Adder'.
Flat, unlit exterior architecture visible through the window lacks atmospheric depth and contrasts poorly with the interior lighting.
Lack of contact shadows (ambient occlusion) beneath desk props like the teacup, books, and inkwell makes them appear to float.
actionable_r2_fixes: Implement `THREE.InstancedMesh` or geometry merging for repetitive bookshelf books, window mullions, and machine gears to cut draw calls below 150.
Fix UI state bindings so selecting a new computation table immediately updates the description text, active program state, and tape register.
Add screen-space ambient occlusion (SSAO) or baked contact shadow planes under desk props, and apply distance fog to the exterior courtyard.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 1936년 케임브리지 서재의 테마 연출과 깔끔한 UI 타이포그래피는 인상적이나, 높은 드로우 콜로 인한 프레임 저하와 초기 로딩 지연이 몰입감을 저해합니다. UI 상태 동기화 버그를 수정하고 인스턴싱 최적화 및 접지 그림자를 보강하여 완성도를 높일 필요가 있습니다.

strengths: Crisp, domain-accurate aerospace HUD that reflows cleanly without overlap in the 700x900 narrow viewport.
Strong multi-stage turbofan CAD hierarchy featuring clear thermal shader mapping and labeled axial exploded views.
Consistent 60 FPS performance with zero console errors at 178k triangles and 73 draw calls.
defects_and_ai_tells: Combustor macro view exhibits harsh additive glow and straight-line particle trails clipping directly through solid stator and rotor geometry.
Cutaway section caps use flat, unshaded beige fills lacking standard CAD cross-hatching or metallic roughness.
Initial load readiness is sluggish at 7,065 ms despite purely procedural geometry.
actionable_r2_fixes: Apply world-space diagonal CAD cross-hatching and subtle bevel normals to the 135-degree cutaway cap faces.
Replace linear streamline ribbons in the combustor with curled, depth-softened volumetric particles that respect blade boundaries.
Defer non-critical geometry generation or use Web Workers to cut the 7-second initialization time below 2 seconds.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 정교한 항공우주 텔레메트리 HUD와 분해도 열화상 모드가 돋보이며 60프레임의 안정적인 성능을 유지합니다. 다만 단면 캡의 단조로운 재질 처리와 연소실 내부 파티클의 기하학적 관통 현상, 느린 초기 로딩 속도는 개선이 필요합니다.

strengths: Cohesive technical HUD aesthetic combining spreadsheet formula bars, cell loupes, and shader telemetry.
Effective dual-mode architecture pairing single-pass WebGL2 hex-lattice curl advection with interactive 2.5D Phong spreadsheet relighting.
Clean responsive layout adaptation at 700x900 with zero console errors and stable 60 FPS median performance.
defects_and_ai_tells: Severe luminance clipping in Mode A's core plume, blowing out internal hex-lattice detail to flat white in both Solar and Argon presets.
Unacceptable 51-second initialization stall (47.3s CPU pre-warm visible in telemetry and HUD).
AI-generated typography tell in Mode B where 'Neon 4' renders ambiguously as 'Noon 4', paired with truncated RGB strings in the bottom-right Loupe overlay.
Minor text truncation on narrow viewports ('04 // CH', preset labels, and bottom-right FPS counter).
actionable_r2_fixes: Eliminate the 47s synchronous CPU pre-warm by moving fluid/sheet initialization to GPU framebuffers or analytic time-offset noise.
Apply ACES or AgX filmic tonemapping before gamma output in Mode A to preserve hexagonal cell structure inside high-temperature cores.
Replace the ambiguous 'Noon 4' source asset with crisp geometric SDF/vector neon lettering and widen Loupe cells to prevent RGB text clipping.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 독창적인 스프레드시트 UI와 육각 격자 유체 셰이더의 결합이 인상적이며 전반적인 프레임 방어력도 준수합니다. 다만 51초에 달하는 초기 로딩 지연과 플룸 중심부의 과도한 화이트아웃 현상, 그리고 모호한 네온 텍스트 에셋은 전시급 완성도를 위해 반드시 개선해야 합니다.

strengths: Cohesive brass-and-emerald HUD design with a live energy ledger and clean responsive collapsing on narrow viewports.
Clear multi-stage Rube Goldberg layout featuring readable XPBD cloth deformation and diagnostic wireframe toggles.
defects_and_ai_tells: Background arcade cabinets clash thematically with the classic wood-and-brass atelier theme and float in a flat, unlit void.
Tabletop wood texture exhibits stretched tiling with weak contact shadows, reducing physical grounding of mechanical props.
Crude unshaded hexagonal wind particles and notable telemetry dips (29.9 P10 FPS and 7068ms load time) detract from polish.
actionable_r2_fixes: Replace out-of-place arcade cabinets with thematic workshop architecture and add baked/screen-space ambient occlusion.
Upgrade procedural/PBR wood roughness maps and swap flat hexagon particles for soft, velocity-aligned wind ribbons.
Profile physics substeps and asset loading to halve the 7s startup time and raise P10 frame rates toward 60 FPS.
blind_critique.verdict_ko: 깔끔한 UI 구성과 다단계 물리 시뮬레이션 및 천(XPBD) 시각화는 준수하게 구현되었습니다. 다만 배경 오브젝트의 테마 부조화, 평면적인 재질 및 조명, 초기 로딩 및 하위 프레임 저하를 개선해야 전시 수준에 도달할 수 있습니다.
